messages:
support-amy: AcmeCorp (tenant acme-42) reporting repeated 504s and p99 tail timeouts since 2025-03-18T16:02Z. Customer saw 5xx spike ~16:02 UTC, attaching repro steps. P1 escalation.

eng-oncall: Can you paste a sample request id + the headers? Also share approximate QPS and model used.

support-amy: sample request id: req_0a1b2c3d
support-amy: curl repro:
```bash
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-scale-7b","input":"<long_document>","max_tokens":4096}'
```

jess: seeing queue_depth spikes on hosted-batcher pool: host cb-07a queue_depth=1216, avg_queue_wait_ms=2245, batch_size_avg=48. Continuous-batching backlog looks saturated; longseq (>=1024 tokens) causing large batches and KV cache warmups, lengthening tail.

samir: deploy-bot reported runtime deploy at 2025-03-18T15:55Z. Not sure if related but callout.

deploy-bot: Deployed rwd-runtime v2.14.3 -> hosted-prod at 2025-03-18T15:55Z :rocket:

chris: Is this multi-tenant or dedicated? If multi-tenant we should throttle the tenant temporarily.

support-amy: hosted shared tenant. We applied temporary ingress limits (rbctl):
`rbctl tenants update acme-42 --ingress-rate 25rps --max-concurrency 8` 
Observed p95 down from 3.2s -> 1.1s after limits, p99 still ~12s for longseq.

eng-oncall: Please capture full trace for req_0a1b2c3d (x-request-id, x-queue-wait-ms, x-batcher-id). Also logs from cb-07a.

support-amy: headers from failing request:
x-request-id: req_0a1b2c3d
x-queue-wait-ms: 2245
x-batcher-id: cb-07a
response: 504 Gateway Timeout

jess: root cause hypothesis: continuous-batching queue depth exceeded because small-sample of long requests bunched into oversized batches; KV cache misses plus kernel fallback increased per-token latency, causing queue hold and eventual 504s. Short-term: (1) force route to low-latency variant (gpt-scale-7b-ll) (2) enforce per-tenant concurrency cap (3) set payload truncation on the client.

samir: for immediate mitigation I recommend adding an early-eviction policy for batches with >1024 seq tokens and enable per-tenant jittered backoff. I'll open infra change ENG-12111.

support-amy: filed support ticket SUP-8429 and linked internal ENG ticket ENG-12111. Sales/account on notice @alex-smith :eyes:

jess: followups: create runbook steps, update routing policy, increase observability on x-queue-wait-ms and batch_size histogram per-tenant. I'll post PR with threshold tweak.

support-amy: marking P1. I'll update customer and ask them to reduce concurrent longseqs while we stabilize. :thumbsup:

chris: assign follow-ups: jess (runtime), samir (infra), eng-oncall (traces). Next sync in 30m.
